scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) Disaster Rebuild Special Window
source: PMAY-G Framework for Implementation (2016, revised 2024), Clause 3.2 (Special Projects for Natural Calamities)
eligibility_conditions: House must be fully damaged or destroyed in an officially notified disaster
Family must be registered on the SECC / Awaas+ permanent waitlist
Family must not own any other pucca house in the country
Dwelling must be located in an eligible rural gram panchayat area
